title: Order export: requirements
tldr: 4 requirements and 1 question for a CSV export endpoint. Main risk: streaming 100k rows.

items.title: Export all orders as CSV
items.body:
When a client calls GET /orders/export, the system shall respond with a CSV file of all orders.
Rows shall stream to the client as they are read, never buffered in full.
items.check: integration test streams 100k rows with flat memory

items.title: One row per order
items.body: Each row shall contain id, customerId, status, total and createdAt, in that order.
items.check: unit tests for escaping edge cases

items.title: Date range filter
items.body: When from or to are given, the system shall include only orders created in that range.
items.check: tests for from only, to only, both, and neither

items.title: Where should orders be read from?

choices.label: A new Postgres orders table with a migration
